title: Ready NGINX runtime snapshots omit the Parent Common source root
title_de: Bereite NGINX-Runtime-Snapshots lassen den Parent-Common-Source-Root aus
security_assessment: No production exploit is claimed. The affected boundary is a Parent-controlled environment hand-off into NGINX configure. The repair must publish only the resolved Parent Common source directory, must not accept a job-provided override, and must retain the Framework's fail-closed missing-source and cache-containment controls.
security_invariant: A ready NGINX direct-runtime snapshot carries only the explicit Common source root derived from the reviewed Parent connector root; no inherited job value, cache-path fallback, or missing-path bypass may become build authority.
sink: Framework prepare-nginx-build.sh NGINX configure invocation and the Parent NGINX adapter config
protocol: Parent verified runtime matrix environment hand-off
profile: Parent PR #74 head c6db0f8ab5b95be67a92ba925a1f4caa3d3d0a1d; original snapshot omission fixed locally and no longer reproduces in hosted preparation
observed_behavior: Earlier exact-head #74 producers completed runtime-component preparation and readiness, then NGINX configure failed with `ngx_http_modsecurity: missing Common source root; set MSCONNECTOR_COMMON_SRC`. The c6db0f8 follow-up then completed Apache and NGINX preparation and configured the NGINX module, so the original omission no longer reproduces. That producer next failed on FND-FRAMEWORK-0057; its Framework repair is now merged and adopted by Parent master, leaving a fresh updated #74 producer and strict terminal gate as the only remaining verification.
expected_behavior: A ready NGINX runtime snapshot publishes the explicit Parent CONNECTOR_ROOT/common/src value so the Framework's normal inherited environment reaches NGINX configure. Missing or invalid source paths remain fail-closed by the existing NGINX adapter config.
impact: The original Parent snapshot omission is locally remediated and no longer reproduces in hosted NGINX preparation. Framework's distinct case-schema blocker is delivered and adopted by Parent master, so PR #74 can now run its full legitimate producer; adding a generic source-path fallback or forwarding a job-provided value remains prohibited.
preconditions: The direct runtime matrix consumes an invocation-local snapshot after NGINX cache preparation.
Framework materializes the NGINX adapter outside the Parent Common source directory.
NGINX configure compiles the adapter Common C sources.
reproduction: Inspect the exact a0f337b8e45e5661b1ed09c7bf39b958548fbd14 hosted NGINX configure diagnostic.
Trace Parent prepare_nginx_runtime, later runtime_env construction, and with-runtime-components.sh snapshot sourcing.
Verify Framework prepare-nginx-build.sh uses normal env inheritance and does not clear MSCONNECTOR_COMMON_SRC.

evidence.command: Read-only exact-head GitHub Actions diagnostic inspection plus Parent/Framework source-to-sink review; focused Parent snapshot and direct-matrix controls

root_cause: prepare_nginx_runtime supplies MSCONNECTOR_COMMON_SRC only to the managed cache build. Later main() reconstructs runtime_env from the ready NGINX record but omitted the Common source root. The invocation-local snapshot is therefore missing the value when with-runtime-components.sh starts the direct Framework runner. Framework's env command inherits values normally, so it is not the omission point.
proposed_remediation: Use the Parent helper nginx_runtime_environment to publish MSCONNECTOR_COMMON_SRC derived only from connector_root/common/src for ready NGINX records. Keep the existing owner-root snapshot values, do not consume an inherited override, and cover ready/unready publication plus direct snapshot propagation with focused tests.
acceptance_criteria: A ready NGINX runtime snapshot contains exactly the Parent-derived MSCONNECTOR_COMMON_SRC value.
An unready NGINX record publishes no NGINX runtime values.
The direct Framework runtime-matrix boundary receives the source-root value from the sourceable invocation-local snapshot.
The existing cache-contained positive and outside-owner negative controls continue to pass.
A new exact #74 hosted producer and strict terminal gate pass without a source-path fallback, guard relaxation, Sonar suppression, or MRTS change.
validation_plan: Run the focused snapshot, matrix owner-root, and component-cache contract tests.
Run CI workflow/security and bilingual-documentation checks for the #74 update.
Push a normal #74 follow-up commit and obtain exact-head GitHub Actions, SonarQube Cloud, review, branch-protection, and protected-integration evidence.
legitimate_control_tests: Ready NGINX snapshot publishes the Parent Common source root.
Direct NGINX matrix runner receives the same sourceable snapshot value.
Cache-contained refresh remains accepted and an outside owner root remains rejected before make.
blocked_by: Parent #74 must merge the current Parent master Gitlink update normally and obtain fresh exact-head hosted producer and strict terminal-gate evidence
Exact-head Parent SonarQube Cloud, review, branch-protection, and protected-integration evidence
deduplication_note: Not a duplicate of FND-CROSS-0008: that finding owns cache refresh deletion-owner containment across Parent and Framework. This finding has a distinct Parent-only cause, sink, invariant, and remediation: omission of the Common source root from a ready direct-runtime snapshot.
residual_risk: The original missing-Common-source condition no longer reproduces. Framework PR #51 is merged and the resulting gitlink is already on Parent master, but a full hosted exact-head producer and strict terminal gate still must rerun on the updated #74 branch. No final runtime success, Parent #74 integration, MRTS change, risk acceptance, or control weakening is claimed.
residual_risk_de: Die ursprüngliche Missing-Common-Source-Bedingung reproduziert nicht mehr. Framework-PR #51 ist gemergt und der resultierende Gitlink bereits auf Parent-master, aber ein vollständiger Hosted-Exact-Head-Producer und das strikte Terminal-Gate müssen noch auf dem aktualisierten #74-Branch erneut laufen. Es werden weder finaler Runtime-Erfolg noch Parent-#74-Integration, MRTS-Änderung, Risikoakzeptanz oder Lockerung einer Kontrolle behauptet.

history.detail: Bounded hosted NGINX configure evidence and source-to-sink review identified Parent runtime snapshot publication as the independently remediable omission.

Exact Parent head c6db0f8 completed Apache/NGINX preparation and configured the NGINX module. The subsequent producer failure is the distinct Framework case-schema blocker FND-FRAMEWORK-0057, so full exact-head terminal-gate verification remains pending external dependency resolution.

Framework PR #51 is merged as de705a5efb872f95f010346fe2e6143c88876ad4 and Parent PR #126 adopted that gitlink on Parent master 3c99b88e1c73dcf7b79c0ea6dd189cb4383d13dd. The prior external dependency is resolved; Parent #74 now needs a normal update from current master plus fresh exact-head producer and strict terminal-gate evidence.
